summary.zh: 分开保存原始讨论与已批准的决策
summary.en: Keep raw transcripts separate from approved decisions

description.zh: 在会议结束后记录决策、负责人和截止时间，并把原始讨论记录与正式通过的结论分开存放。可查询历史决策、检查逾期事项、发现前后矛盾。记录存档需要运行随附的 Python 脚本。
description.en: Logs decisions with owner, deadline and review date, keeping raw discussion separate from what was approved. Supports searching past decisions and checking overdue actions. Records rely on a bundled Python script.
